themes.description: Users report that accessing, viewing, managing, and paying for credit cards causes severe lag, freezes, crashes, and long loading times across the FD credit card section.
themes.business_impact: High transaction abandonment and missed payments lead to customer dissatisfaction, eroding trust in the platform’s financial services and increasing churn risk.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The credit card module likely suffers from memory leaks or inefficient rendering (e.g., unoptimized list adapters), excessive network requests, and lack of proper error handling, causing frame‑rate drops and crashes on many devices.
themes.action_plan:
• Profile memory and network usage in the credit card module
• Refactor UI to use efficient list rendering (e.g., RecyclerView with view holders)
• Implement batched, paginated data fetching and caching
• Add robust error handling and graceful fallbacks for network failures
• Instrument crash reporting to capture stack traces
• Deploy incremental updates with monitoring of crash rates
• Conduct QA testing on low‑end and high‑end devices
• Update support docs with troubleshooting steps for credit card issues
